summary: @servicetitan/thoughtspot-theme 1.7.2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's declared preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) runs an obfuscated script that, when a system `bun` binary is absent, downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, extracts and chmods it executable, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is a 727KB javascript-obfuscator-shaped bundle (rotated string array, hex-numbered identifiers, `_0x` name scheme, shift-rotate permutation function) whose contents are not humanly readable and are executed unconditionally at `npm install` time. Using a freshly downloaded alternate runtime to execute the payload is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern that bypasses Node-oriented install-time scanning. The package's `package.json` declares `"files": ["dist"]`, but both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` ship at the tarball root outside the declared manifest; the `dist/` library code is a benign ThoughtSpot theme, consistent with an impersonation of a ServiceTitan package with an added dropper. A CSS/theme library has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install and execute an opaque 727KB blob under it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
